source.title: Targeted original Dragonflight processing event-ledger search across primary and archival sites

notes: No NEW source-original numeric cohort with independently verified output-item rank, completed prospect/mill casts, Resourcefulness refunds, per-output castsWithDrop, true zero outcomes, or quantity histogram found. Do not count historical Bugy/Jallfo/Xenastro, Aary/Liqourice5, superbondez, Reddit zkay8v, or translated/PTR reposts anew. Approximate 'about 40' remains approximate; PTR and beta mechanics do not create modern measured cohorts. No numeric or model claims derived.
lookingFor: Original 0/1/2+ per-completed-operation prospect or mill event logs for rank-separated Draconium Ore 189143/188658/190311, Serevite Ore 190394/190395/190396, Khaz'gorite Ore 190312/190313/190314, Prismatic Ore 194545, Bubble Poppy 191467, Saxifrage 191464/191465/191466, and outputs 194545, 192870/192871, 192872/192880, 198412/198413/198414, 198418/198419/198420; published with source rank, skill/spec, patch, refunded ore/herbs and duplicate cohort identity.
whereLooked: GitHub named Dragonflight 'Prospecting SavedVariables' raw-results search (site:github.com 'Dragonflight' 'Prospecting' 'SavedVariables' results): no public player-per-operation source was located; search surfaced addon implementation references rather than sampled casts.
Pastebin search by 'Prismatic Ore' prospecting 100 and Dragonflight original result log (site:pastebin.com 'Prismatic Ore' '100' 'prospect'): no attributable per-cast output/refund text surfaced.
YouTube search for 'Bubble Poppy' milling pigment samples with quantities (site:youtube.com/watch 'Bubble Poppy' 'milling' 'pigment' results): no source-original per-mill table surfaced.
Blizzard EU forums search for 'Saxifrage' 'milling' 1000 pigments (site:eu.forums.blizzard.com): no usable independently counted operations or 0-N event distributions surfaced.

Reddit r/woweconomy name searches 'Draconium Ore' prospecting histogram/zeros and 'Saxifrage' milling results: surfaced no novel per-output 0,1,2,... series; historical original 1000-prospect Serevite table already indexed https://www.reddit.com/r/woweconomy/comments/zkay8v .

Wowhead French original commenter Zuhla on named Prismatic Ore https://www.wowhead.com/fr/item=194545/minerai-prismatique reports *approximately* 40 Prismatic from 5000 nominal rank-3 Draconium; already indexed source in dragonflight/2026-11-01T0230, approximate units not castsWithDrop.

Wowhead English named Prismatic Ore superbondez original https://www.wowhead.com/item=194545/prismatic-ore: 400 ore/80 stated prospects and original material totals previously indexed; no per-material 0-N histogram; multilingual PTR mirrors duplicate same author.

Wowhead named Serene/Blazing/Shimmering pigments https://www.wowhead.com/item=198412/serene-pigment ; https://www.wowhead.com/item=198418/blazing-pigment ; https://www.wowhead.com/item=198422/shimmering-pigment: source describes milling origin but no new Bubble Poppy or Saxifrage sample event logs; Aary's Saxifrage original is already indexed.

Icy Veins named Bubble Poppy milling guide https://www.icy-veins.com/wow/professions-herbalism-bountiful-harvests-talent-build: source links ingredient-to-pigment use, no independent per-cast yield sample.
Warcraft Wiki named Flourishing Pigment https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Flourishing_Pigment: 5-herb milling recipe fact, but no original rank/skill/refund-adjusted sample.

Wowhead original Liqourice5 Dragonflight 2022-beta milling reference republished in https://www.wowhead.com/cn/news/crafting-work-orders-are-here-wowhead-economy-weekly-wrap-up-251-329620 : 2-5 beta reference values, not postlaunch measured current cast histograms.
